excerpt.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的探测器发现一个近期被[from.GetAffectedStormType]带进这个恒星系的不明物体。

需要近距离调查以验证该异常物体的本质。
excerpt.en:
Sensors in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have detected an unknown object brought into the system by the recent [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Closer inspection is needed to verify the nature of the anomaly.

需要近距离调查以验证该异常物体的本质。
sections.en:
Sensors in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have detected an unknown object brought into the system by the recent [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Closer inspection is needed to verify the nature of the anomaly.

texts.zh: 我们发现，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的怪异物体其实是一大团来自某种太空生物的有机残留物。由于所有可供识别的特征都被宇宙风暴撕碎了，所以无法对这些生物碎片进行准确分类。
texts.en: The foreign object in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was discovered to be a large mass of organic remains originating from some type of spaceborne fauna. Having had any identifiable features shredded apart by the cosmic storm, it is impossible to correctly catalog the biological debris.

texts.zh: 幸运的是，大部分仍可食用。
[leader.GetName]确信，对该生物遗骸进行更详细的法医分析将揭示更多有关其起源性质的信息，以及[from.GetAffectedStormType]对类似太空生物的影响。
texts.en: [leader.GetName] is confident that a more detailed forensic analysis of the creature's remains would reveal more information about the nature of its origins and the effects of a [from.GetAffectedStormType] on similar space faring organisms.

texts.zh: 我们在[solar_system.GetName]星系发现了被宇宙风暴夹带着穿越星系的某种未知生物的遗骸。对待这具遗骸进行法医鉴定可以揭示更多信息。
texts.en: We have encountered the remains of an unknown creature in the [solar_system.GetName] system dragged across the galaxy by a cosmic storm. Forensic dissection of the corpse should reveal more information.

texts.zh:
经过了谨慎的解剖，这团肉块究竟属于什么物种仍是个谜。在风暴中心遭受的巨大破坏使它失去了一切可供识别的特征和遗传标记。

然而，在这项研究的过程中，我们获得了对宇宙风暴组成的洞见，了解了其对外星生物质的破坏性影响。
texts.en:
After careful dissection, the original species of this visceral mass remains a mystery. The extraordinary damage taken in the epicenter of the storm has stripped it of any recognizable features or genetic markers.

However, in the process of this study we have gained insight into the composition of Cosmic Storms and their devastating effects on xenobiological matter.
